text_content: > Prevent usage of `` with `Head` component from `next/document`. ## Why This Error Occurred A `<title>` element was defined within the `Head` component imported from `next/document`, which should only be used for any `<head>` code that is common for all pages. Title tags should be defined at the page-level using `next/head` instead. ## Possible Ways to Fix It Within a page or component, import and use `next/head` to define a page title: ```jsx filename="pages/index.js" import Head from 'next/head' export function Home() { return ( <div> <Head> <title>My page title ) } ``` ## Useful Links - [next/head](/docs/pages/api-reference/components/head) - [Custom Document](/docs/pages/building-your-application/routing/custom-document)Prevent usage of `` with `` component from ``.
